A shift at the front desk

  • Before arrivals

    Review the arrivals list, flag special requests, and check room readiness with housekeeping.

  • Check-in and checkout

    Confirm booking details, explain deposits and timings, issue keys, and review the folio with guests before payment.

  • Shift handover

    Record open guest requests, promised follow-up times, and which department will take the next action.

Guest-service scenarios

Three practice cases from front-office training.

An early arrival and a room that’s still being prepared

Aditi’s response

I’d confirm the booking, check the expected release time with housekeeping, and offer luggage storage and a place to wait. I’d agree on when the guest will hear from me and record the follow-up for the desk.

A reservation that isn’t on the arrivals list

Aditi’s response

I’d ask for the confirmation number and booking channel, then check the dates and property with the guest. If it still didn’t appear, I’d involve reservations or the duty manager and explain the available options and rates before confirming any new booking.

A guest disputes a charge at checkout

Aditi’s response

I’d listen, review the itemised folio with the guest, and check the posting with the department that added it. I’d explain what we verified, refer any adjustment to the authorised supervisor, and record the outcome in the handover.

Hotel reception trainee · 2025

  • Assisted with arrivals, room assignments, departures, and guest requests under a supervisor.
  • Coordinated room status with housekeeping and prepared end-of-shift handovers.

Diploma in Hotel Management

Front-office coursework · 2024–2025

  • Practised reservation updates, room-status checks, and guest folios in a training property management system.
  • Completed role-play drills for complaint handling, billing queries, and service follow-up.
